# ANALYSIS: OOS_REALFILLS_VALIDATION_TOP3_J_DAYS

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis_validation  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to verify the baseline engine's behavior on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and the three J loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) using out-of-sample (OOS) validation and real-fills replay. This will confirm the engine's edge_capture on the OP-16 anchor set and ensure any proposed changes are grounded in realistic fill assumptions.

## Mechanism

Run the baseline engine (no candidate modifications) over the period 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 with OPRA real-fills simulator. Collect P&L for each of the six J anchor days. Compute edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers)). Compare against the known ideal winner P&Ls (+$342, +$470, +$730) and ideal loser outcomes (skip or minimal loss).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈ 14% headline scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** Using OPRA cache 2025-01-02..2026-06-18 (16 months). Selection is all J anchor days (fixed set). Overfit risk low as anchor days are immutable source-of-truth.
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS validation is the real-fills replay itself (in-sample vs OOS not applicable for anchor-day verification). We treat the full period as OOS for engine behavior; anchor days are holdout by design.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (requires running engine with OPRA simulator; not yet executed in this analysis).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day would be a loser day where engine takes large loss; max drawdown scenario from consecutive loser-day losses; blow-up if engine overtrades winners with excessive size.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X. Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.
